I do not have money for chemical fertilizer, and one bag from the shop is too much for this small plot anyway. I will spread the manure from my chickens and goats like I have always done, and I will plant the seeds I kept from last year’s harvest. My grandchildren will bring their hoes to help me weed when the rains come, but I will not hire anyone because paying workers is too expensive for me now.
